title: Version 1.64.0
html:
Version 1.64.0 (🏠 The Base Preset Update! 🏘️)

August 13th, 2024

Added:

  • Creating a slot now allows you to select a base preset, which are obtainable for Robux.
  • The presets come with a bunch of starter gear, one even has a bunker basement!
  • All of the brand new presets are created by Azylo, thank you to them!
  • A mystery fruit has been added to the game. We thought it would be fun to not tell you what fruit it is, or where it's even located! Have fun finding out :)
  • Bulb Powered Lights are now available at Alan's Autologistics!
  • Light up your base with some awesome lights, each bulb is fully controllable with logic.
  • Fun fact: the code for the Bulb Powered Lights is a direct copy of the LCD!

Fixed:

  • Fixed a rare bug where purchasing a license plate would censor the text even if it passed the filter.
